title: An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Density estimation with generative models is a common task in the physical sciences, for example in background estimation in particle physics. Existing machine learning techniques, however, lack methods to quantify uncertainties that can be propagated into a statistical test. That limits the validation of generative models to standard goodness-of-fit tests, in which the generative model is treated as exact (point-null hypothesis). But a model fitted to a finite training set is never exact, so if its uncertainties are neglected, any sufficiently powerful goodness-of-fit test will eventually reject it once the test set is large enough to resolve this estimation error. We propose SIGMA, an end-to-end framework combining density estimation with principled uncertainty quantification. We use Gaussian mixture models, for which uncertainties are tractable, and further construct a new goodness-of-fit test in which these uncertainties are profiled

translated_title: 一个用于生成模型不确定性感知验证的端到端框架
translated_abstract: 使用生成模型进行密度估计是物理科学中的一项常见任务，例如粒子物理学中的背景估计。然而，现有的机器学习技术缺乏能够将不确定性传播到统计检验中的量化方法。这使得生成模型的验证只能局限于标准的拟合优度检验，而在这类检验中，生成模型被视为完全精确的（点零假设）。但拟合于有限训练集的模型永远不可能是完全精确的，因此如果忽略其不确定性，一旦测试集足够大以至于能够分辨出这种估计误差，任何足够强大的拟合优度检验最终都会拒绝该模型。我们提出了SIGMA，一个将密度估计与原则性不确定性量化相结合的端到端框架。我们使用高斯混合模型，其不确定性是可解析处理的，并进一步构建了一种新的拟合优度检验，其中这些不确定性被纳入剖面化处理。
tldr: 提出SIGMA端到端框架，通过高斯混合模型将密度估计与原则性不确定性量化相结合，并构建了一种将模型不确定性剖面化的新拟合优度检验，解决了生成模型验证中忽略估计误差导致模型终将被拒绝的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SIGMA, an end-to-end framework that combines Gaussian mixture model-based density estimation with principled uncertainty quantification, and introduces a new goodness-of-fit test that profiles model uncertainties, addressing the problem that generative models with neglected estimation errors will eventually be rejected by sufficiently powerful tests.
